title: Singapore Private Residential Market Predictor Report
scope_summary: Singapore private non-landed residential sale prices and rents, using public macroeconomic, financial, demographic, and market-level indicators.
user_objective: Describe recent validated movements in the selected indicators and explain how they may be informative for sale-price and rental-market monitoring.

predictor_rationales.ura_non_landed_price_index: The official URA non-landed price index is the sale-market outcome benchmark; it is reported as an outcome and is not used as a predictor.
predictor_rationales.ura_non_landed_rental_index: The official URA non-landed whole-island rental index is the rental-market outcome benchmark; it is reported as an outcome and is not used as a predictor.
predictor_rationales.three_month_compounded_sora: Short-term financing conditions may affect mortgage affordability and leveraged purchase demand in the sale market.
predictor_rationales.real_gdp_growth: Broad economic activity may affect income expectations, purchasing capacity, and buyer confidence.
predictor_rationales.non_resident_population: The non-resident population is a structural measure of part of the potential foreign-facing tenant base.
predictor_rationales.non_resident_employment_change: Quarterly non-resident employment change is a timely demand signal, but it is an employment flow rather than a population stock.
predictor_rationales.private_non_landed_vacancy_rate: Vacancy measures completed-market tightness and may be informative for rental pressure.
predictor_rationales.private_residential_pipeline_supply: The future housing pipeline may affect sale and rental conditions after projects are completed.
